statements.status_notes: Three patches applied from Debian 3.21.12-15 (CVE-2025-4565-1 through CVE-2025-4565-3). Fixes denial of service in the Pure-Python protobuf backend when parsing untrusted input.
Five patches applied from Debian 3.21.12-15 (CVE-2024-7254-1 through CVE-2024-7254-5). Adds recursion depth limits when parsing nested Protocol Buffer messages to prevent stack overflow.

CVE-2015-5237 is an integer overflow in MessageLite serialization when a message exceeds 2 GiB. Protobuf 3.21.12 (the upstream version in this Debian source package) uses ByteSizeLong() and rejects serialization when ByteSizeLong() exceeds INT_MAX before allocating buffers (see src/google/protobuf/message_lite.cc in protocolbuffers/protobuf v3.21.12). Debian security tracking still lists the CVE as unfixed, but the shipped 3.21.12 sources include the upstream mitigation from protobuf 3.4.0+.
